shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab/panel
animal or creature shown in profile
horizontal register-like divisions of the surface
repeated row of similar motifs forming a band
justification: Both are shallow relief panels with content organised into horizontal registers, including a band of repeated motifs and profile creatures, but that is about as generic as relief iconography gets. A shows a single large anthropomorphic winged figure in profile with elaborate garment, beard, headdress and a held object, dominating the field, while B shows only animals (a quadruped/feline in profile, a bird-like head, small crouching figures) and abstract signs with no human figure and quite different, far more schematic proportions and detailing.
